monthly_signal_schedule: Use the same first-session monthly signal dates as V11/V26 in the strict holdout.

sleeves.name: 60d adjusted-price momentum Top2
sleeves.membership_source: V11 shared monthly schedule; rank four banks by adjusted close at signal close vs 60 sessions prior.

portfolio_rule: At each monthly signal, assign 25% of total account equity to each of the two V26 factor names and 25% to each of the two 60d momentum names. If a name overlaps, add its sleeve weights (50% for one-name overlap; 50% each when both pairs match). The four target weights sum to 100% before rounding at execution.
execution: Target weights from signal close execute at next trading-session open via V11 final shared-cash ledger; sell excess first, then buy using available cash.

costs_and_constraints.zero_target_odd_lot_exit_rule: V11 final engine; sell residual odd lots only on full exits when participation cap covers entire remaining position.

comparison_window: All strategies start at 2024-01-02 and mark through 2026-06-30; no forced end liquidation or appended exit-only day.
rule_source: V30 user-specified fixed 50/50 sleeve mix; V26 frozen memberships; no held-out result is used to set factor, sleeves, or weights.
